summary.en: Chinese militia boats are increasing battlefield preparation in the western Pacific while the Chinese coast guard continues to monitor Philippine resupply missions to the grounded warship at the disputed shoal. The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 20 people off Basilan and opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island, but its personnel were killed and another wounded in a shooting in Cotabato City. Taiwan has offered cooperation with the Philippines on protecting undersea cables and an ex-NSA has urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske militsbåter øker forberedelsene til kamp i det vestlige Stillehavet mens den kinesiske kystvakten fortsetter å overvåke filippinske forsyningsoppdrag til det strandede krigsskipet på den omstridte sandbanke. Filippinernes kystvakt reddet 20 personer utenfor Basilan og åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya, men deres personell ble drept og en annen såret i en skyting i Cotabato City. Taiwan har tilbudt samarbeid med Filippinene om beskyttelse av undersjøiske kabler og en tidligere NSA har oppfordret til aktivering av avtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina om kystvakten. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
